name: stt
description: Speech-to-text via the internal whisper.cpp server (Swarm service `stt` on the animus overlay). Uploads audio from the package files area kernel-side (ctx.http.upload, #69 seam) and returns the transcript. Transcription is side-effect-free: writes_gated is off by design and the egress allowlist (host `stt` only) is the boundary.

commands.name: transcribe
commands.description: Transcribe an audio file from the package files area (wav/ogg/webm/mp3 — the server converts via ffmpeg). The full transcript is also persisted to <file>.txt in the files area. Boundary: single-request timeout is 300 s (kernel clamp); chunk longer audio before upload. Requires a kernel with ctx.http.upload (#69).
commands.script: function run(ctx) local base = ctx.package.get_state('base_url') local r = ctx.http.upload(base..'/inference', {files = {{name = ctx.args.file, field = 'file', mime = ctx.args.mime or 'application/octet-stream'}}, fields = {response_format = 'json'}, timeout_s = 300}) if r.status ~= 200 or not (r.json and r.json.text) then return {success = false, output = 'transcribe failed: HTTP '..tostring(r.status)..(r.error and (' - '..tostring(r.error)) or '')} end local text = r.json.text local path = ctx.fs.write(ctx.args.file..'.txt', text) return {output = 'transcribed '..tostring(#text)..' chars', data = {text = text, transcript_path = path}} end
